name: misteralg
description: MisterALG: interpretador, editor e depurador de Portugol para Windows, macOS e Linux, inspirado no VisuAlg

scripts.test: npm run test:interpreter && npm run test:busca && npm run test:compat
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac -w misteralg-app
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w misteralg-app
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w misteralg-app
